title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Corporate Governance and Leadership
description: Elevate strategic decision-making and ethical leadership with the Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Corporate Governance and Leadership.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Corporate Governance and Leadership offers advanced corporate management and ethical decision-making insights. Participants will explore contemporary governance frameworks, leadership dynamics, and regulatory compliance. The program will equip executives with the skills to drive organizational success and sustainability. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Corporate Governance and Leadership allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The aim of the Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Corporate Governance and Leadership is to develop high-calibre executives capable of navigating complex governance challenges. The program seeks to enhance strategic leadership skills and foster a deep understanding of ethical decision-making. It strives to prepare participants to lead with integrity and drive organizational excellence. Course Details: Applied Corporate and Business Law: Examine the legal frameworks and regulations that underpin corporate operations and governance. Corporate Management and Control: Explore mechanisms for effective oversight and control within corporate structures. Corporate Stewardship: Learn principles and practices for responsible management and long-term value creation. Corporate Social Responsibility and Governance: Study the integration of ethical practices and social responsibility into corporate governance. Financial Reporting and Analysis: Gain expertise in interpreting and utilizing financial reports for informed decision-making. Strategic Leadership: Develop advanced skills for guiding organizations through strategic planning and execution. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Corporate Governance and Leadership and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There are no Visa Requirements for this Programme as it's as Online Course.

modules.title: APPLIED CORPORATE AND BUSINESS LAW
modules.summary: Module Aim The Aim of studying different laws governing the structure of corporate governance is to enable the learner to know the rights of each player. The ideal corporate structure with a command and control system that avoids misinformation and abuse of power so that proper action can be taken on time. This module takes the learner through rules and regulations passed by different governments worldwide and the OECD best practices in corporate affairs.
